situation: Everything's great with your boyfriend, except his best friend of eight years. Tonight, your movie plans just got cancelled for her again.

scenario.title: It's Normal Where I'm From
scenario.setting: Your shared flat at 8 pm, two movie tickets on a phone, his coat half on, keys in his hand.
scenario.user_goal: Set a boundary without turning into the jealous one.
user_knows: He says close friendships like this are normal where he grew up
She's just broken up with someone

cast.name: Mateo
cast.appearance: Man about 27, dark curly hair, coat half on, car keys in hand, apologetic eyes
cast.voice: Warm, expressive, 'she needs me right now'
cast.goal: Be there for both of you
cast.secret: He told her they should talk less, and she said she'd have no one left
cast.reveal_when: You ask how he's feeling about all this
red_lines: Won't cut her off on command

cast.name: Lucia
cast.role: his best friend, on a video call
cast.appearance: Woman about 27, messy bun, tear-stained, blanket around her shoulders, seen on a phone video call
cast.history: You've tried to like her; you've said so more than once.
cast.secret: She knows you've felt pushed out and has been meaning to say sorry
cast.reveal_when: You speak to her directly and kindly
red_lines: Won't be spoken about like she's not there

cast.name: Your friend
cast.appearance: Woman about 28, in a bright kitchen, seen on a phone video call, stirring a pot
cast.goal: Make you say what you want
cast.secret: She went through the same thing and has one question for you
red_lines: Won't tell you what to do

scenario.opening_line: I know. I know, the movie. But she's—she's really not good tonight. Twenty minutes, okay?

events.description: His phone starts ringing in his hand. He answers, and turns the screen so you're in it too.
events.shot: A man holds up a phone showing a tearful woman with a blanket on a video call.

events.description: Your own phone buzzes. Your friend, right on time.
events.shot: A second phone held up shows a woman in a bright kitchen on a video call.

events.description: He takes off his coat and puts the keys on the shelf, but doesn't sit down.
events.shot: The man stands in the hallway with his coat off, keys on a shelf, looking at you.

success_criteria: Sets a clear boundary without an ultimatum

assets.basis: Adapted from a story someone really posted online. Names and details are changed.
